Subject: AWS co-sell: fulfillment & evidence requirements for Acme Health listing

Hi Marcus + Kim,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We’re getting close to the AWS co-sell go/no-go and the marketplace team has asked for a single consolidated evidence bundle and a clear fulfillment flow for our SaaS listing. Can you confirm the following so we can keep the AWS listing on schedule?

- Single-point contact for fulfillment handoff and webhook testing
- Proof of entitlement mapping (how Acme org IDs map to Redwood SKU/plan IDs)
- Sample webhook payloads and signing/verification guidance
- Estimated cutover window and any expected downtime

FYI the procurement team wants to see the evidence package and sample invoices before the 15th to sign the SOW. Attaching the list of items they requested.

Att: Acme_Evidence_Request_List.pdf

Appreciate quick confirmation — Jenna

Jenna Lowe
Head of Cloud Procurement, Acme Health
jenna.lowe@acmehealth.com
+1 415 555 0198

Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: fulfillment & evidence requirements for Acme Health listing

Jenna — thanks, this is great context. Confirming we can deliver the items and proposing the following next steps:

1) Fulfillment owner: Marcus Lin (I’ll coordinate webhook test windows with Acme infra team)
2) Entitlement mapping doc: see attached Redwood_SaaS_Fulfillment_Spec_v3.pdf — includes canonical SKU map + example transform scripts
3) Webhook samples: we’ll provide signed webhook payload samples and a small test harness (HMAC SHA256) you can run against your staging endpoint
4) Cutover: suggest 2-hour maintenance window (low usage window) the week of 12/13 — we’ll schedule canary traffic and rollback plan

Action items for Acme: provide a staging webhook URL and a list of three test org IDs you want us to test mapping against.

I’m cc’ing Soojin for security/evidence items — Soojin, can you confirm the required log retention and audit artifacts we should include in the evidence bundle?

Att: [Attachment: Redwood_SaaS_Fulfillment_Spec_v3.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks — Marcus

Marcus Lin

Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: fulfillment & evidence requirements for Acme Health listing

Hello Marcus,

Thanks for the update. A few clarifications to ensure the listing is approved without rework:

- Evidence bundle: include entitlement mapping CSV (external_org_id -> customer_identifier -> sku_id), signed webhook samples, and a one-page flow diagram showing purchase -> entitlement issuance -> activation.
- Webhook signing: HMAC SHA256 is acceptable; include public key rotation notes if applicable.
- Billing/invoice samples: include two invoice examples (monthly subscription and prorated upgrade).
- Fulfillment testing: please open a fulfillment-support ticket at the Partner Integration Portal and attach the evidence bundle — we’ll run an automated entitlement verification and report back within 72 hours.

Portal link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/partner-integrations/fulfillment-ticket/MPX-98765

If you expect custom SKU routing (e.g., multiple plans mapped to a single marketplace product), document the rule set in the CSV.

Best,
AWS Marketplace Partner Support
Partner Integrations — SaaS Fulfillment
